title: GateReport
description: One JSON object printed on stdout by `agent-receipt capture|wrap|share|verify --json`. Human progress stays on stderr. This is the CI gate, not the companion receipt file (docs/receipt.schema.json). `ok` is true only when `exitCode` is 0. Exit 0 passes. Exit 2 is a --fail-on match and/or a verify failure (the artifact is still written when capture/wrap/share got that far). Exit 1 is a usage or runtime error (`reason` is set); it is not a policy failure. `verified` is null when the command did not run verify (capture, and usage errors). `trailingIgnored` is a boolean when a body was hashed (verify, and wrap/share after they verify) and null when trailing content was not evaluated (capture, and usage errors). Config `failOn` is not applied by verify unless `--fail-on` is explicit. Optional `signature` is present on verify --json only when --require-sig ran after a passing hash. Optional `sigPath` is present on share --json (string or null). Optional `packagePath` is present on share --json only when --package wrote a directory; htmlPath, markdownPath, and sigPath then point inside it. Those optional keys are omitted otherwise. Required keys are unchanged.

command.description: Command that printed this gate object.

version.description: agent-receipt CLI version that printed the gate.

exitCode.description: 0 pass, 2 policy and/or verify failure, 1 usage or runtime error.

verified.description: Whether verify passed. Null when this command did not run verify (capture) or the run stopped before verify.

failedOn.description: True when --fail-on matched the receipt risk summary.

failOn.description: Threshold that was applied, or null when no threshold was set.

redacted.description: True when the written body was redacted.

uncommitted.description: True when the receipt snapshots a dirty working tree. Null when unknown or not applicable.

path.description: Absolute Markdown receipt path, or null on a usage error.

jsonPath.description: Companion receipt JSON path when one was written. Not this gate object.

htmlPath.description: HTML path written by share. With share --package this is receipt.html inside the package. Null for capture, wrap, and verify.

markdownPath.description: Extra Markdown path written by share --md or share --package (receipt.md). Null otherwise.

tldr.description: One-line TL;DR when the command produced one.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt body, or null when no body was hashed.

risk.description: Risk counts from the receipt summary. Null when no summary was produced.

ignored.description: Count of paths skipped by ignore globs, when the command computed one.

trailingIgnored.description: True when content after ## Integrity was ignored by the hash. Boolean when a body was hashed. Null on capture and on usage errors.

reason.description: Human reason for exit 1, or for an exit 2 policy/verify failure. Null when the gate passed.

signature.description: Optional. verify --json includes this only when --require-sig was passed and the hash check passed. Omitted when the signature was not required. Same fields as prove signature. trusted is additive (1.0.18): true, false, or null. Required signature keys are unchanged.

trusted.description: True when a non-empty known-keys allowlist lists this fingerprint. False when that allowlist rejects it or the store failed to load after a valid signature. Null when the allowlist is inactive or trust was not evaluated.

sigPath.description: Optional. share --json sets the sidecar path copied or re-signed beside published Markdown, or null when none was attached. With share --package this is receipt.sig.json inside the package when a sidecar was attached. Omitted on capture, wrap, and verify.

packagePath.description: Optional. share --json --package sets the handoff directory when one was written. Omitted when share did not write a package. htmlPath, markdownPath, and sigPath point at files inside this directory.
